title: AiVanceCareerMemory
description: Longitudinal career memory entry tracking historical skill evolution, interview performance, career weaknesses, empirical metrics, and grounding references across time.

id.description: Unique identifier for this career memory node (UUID v4)

userId.description: Candidate user identifier associated with memory entry

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when observation occurred

category.description: Domain category of longitudinal career observation

evidenceType.description: Empirical evidence source underpinning this memory

strengths.description: Observed competencies, exemplary answers, or verified proficiencies

weaknesses.description: Identified areas for improvement, knowledge gaps, or interview stumbling blocks

metrics.description: Quantitative telemetry, scoring parameters, and benchmark scores

groundingReferences.description: Direct citations, transcript passages, or document offsets grounding the memory

summary.description: High-level synthesized executive summary of this memory entry

retentionPolicy.description: Data lifecycle retention period for compliance and pruning

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when entry was recorded

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when entry was last amended

sourceUri.description: URI or URI-fragment locating source material (e.g. 'aivance://interview/session-99#q-3')

quote.description: Verbatim quote or transcript excerpt supporting the memory
